gloss: riding on someone's shoulders; shoulder ride

definitions.gloss: riding on someone's shoulders; shoulder ride; piggyback on shoulders
definitions.explanation: Carrying a person (usually a child) on one's shoulders, with their legs hanging down on either side of the carrier's neck. A common sight at festivals, parades, and family outings.

examples.japanese: ⟦{父|ちち}→父：00566_chichi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{肩車|かたぐるま}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦もらった→もらう：00520_morau⟧。
examples.english: My father gave me a shoulder ride.

examples.japanese: ⟦{花火|はなび}{大会|たいかい}→花火大会：10105_hanabitaikai⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{子供|こども}→子供：00554_kodomo⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{肩車|かたぐるま}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I carried my child on my shoulders at the fireworks festival.

examples.japanese: {人混|ひとご}み⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{前|まえ}→前：02255_mae⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{見|み}えない→見える：01165_mieru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、{肩車|かたぐるま}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{見|み}せて→見せる：01988_miseru⟧⟦あげた→あげる：00546_ageru⟧。
examples.english: Since they couldn't see past the crowd, I put them on my shoulders so they could see.

notes:
COMMON PATTERNS:
Used with ⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: {肩車|かたぐるま}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to give a shoulder ride) or {肩車|かたぐるま}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧. The person being carried is not usually the subject — the carrier performs the action.

USAGE:
{肩車|かたぐるま} is a warm, nostalgic word associated with childhood memories. It literally combines ⟦{肩|かた}→肩：02192_kata⟧ (shoulder) and ⟦{車|くるま}→車：00516_kuruma⟧ (vehicle), suggesting the shoulders as a kind of vehicle for the child.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {肩車|かたぐるま}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to give a shoulder ride)
- {肩車|かたぐるま}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦もらう→もらう：00520_morau⟧ (to get a shoulder ride)
- ⟦{子供|こども}→子供：00554_kodomo⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{肩車|かたぐるま}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to carry a child on one's shoulders)
